Issue Title: [BUG] Context passed even when explicitly told not to

Description:
### Description

Creating a Task(... context=[]) still receives context string from all sequentially previous tasks.

### Steps to Reproduce

1. create a crew of 3 tasks
2. mark the 3rd task as `context=[]`
3. observe that final task includes outputs of previous 2 tasks.

### Expected behavior

Final task does not have any context

### Screenshots/Code snippets

I had to dump final task prompt to notice this (screenshot below)

I modified crewai\agent.py def execute_task() `if context:` part to print the fact that context was being passed.

### Operating System

Ubuntu 20.04

### Python Version

3.10

### crewAI Version

0.118.0

### crewAI Tools Version

n/a

### Virtual Environment

Venv

### Evidence

![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/4a78d4cb-1710-4ba9-84f4-c45d31f812d3)

### Possible Solution

I couldn't figure out what appends the context.

### Additional context

None
